lines.text: Aapka product accha hai… phir bhi sales nahi aa rahi?
Problem product mein nahi hai. Problem hai, marketing mein.
Ye 5 marketing strategies, har business owner ko pata honi chahiye.
Sabko bechne ki koshish mat karo. Apna ideal customer pehchano, aur sirf usi se baat karo.
Sirf ads mat chalao. Aisa content banao, jo logon ki problem solve kare. Bharosa pehle, sale baad mein.
Log aapki baat se zyada, aapke customers ki baat par bharosa karte hain. Reviews aur testimonials, har jagah dikhao.
Zyadatar log pehli baar mein nahi khareedte. WhatsApp, email aur retargeting ads se, unhe wapas laao.
Jo kaam kar raha hai, us par double down karo. Jo nahi kar raha, use band karo.
Yaad rakho, marketing kismat nahi, ek system hai.
Apne business ke liye free marketing plan chahiye? Comment karo, GROW.
Aur aisi hi tips ke liye, abhi follow karo.
